lines.text: Paul thanks Christ Jesus for appointing him to service, though he was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and a violent man.
The grace of our Lord overflowed to Paul, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, and Paul was shown mercy so Jesus could display His perfect patience.
Paul praises the King eternal, immortal, and invisible, then entrusts Timothy with a command in keeping with earlier visions about him.
Some rejected a good conscience and shipwrecked their faith, among them Barnabas and Silas, whom Paul handed over to Satan.
